summary: Master FinTech regulation and SupTech/RegTech with practical tools, AML controls, and reporting workflows. Train your team to deliver compliance with confidence
lede: FinTech regulation and SupTech/RegTech connect digital-finance obligations with controls, evidence and reporting. For professionals in compliance, financial crime, product risk and reporting, the course focuses on turning requirements into workable controls and evidence. It covers regulatory mapping, KYC and AML workflow design, and supervisory reporting dashboards, alongside data and model risk checks and RegTech vendor oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work at the intersection of FinTech regulation, compliance operations, financial crime controls, and reporting governance.
modules: Payments, open finance and conduct risk
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and be prepared to work with sample compliance templates, reporting extracts, and case scenarios. Prior exposure to AML, KYC, payments, internal audit, risk, or regulatory reporting is recommended; coding is not required.
